world: Decaying two-dimensional turbulence (vorticity form, pseudo-spectral, 2/3 dealiasing, RK4) at resolution n from a seeded random field with spectrum k^3 exp(-(k/k_peak)^2), snapshots at declared times; the consumer is the spectral cutoff at k_c (the large-eddy filter, the budget); the read operator of the resolved tendency with respect to the subfilter state is probed blind on the solver by central finite differences on every subfilter coefficient; closures at matched rank r: the leading eigen-directions of the read operator (the declared arm), the subfilter modes of largest read energy (sensitivity-weighted energy, the read distortion), the modes of largest energy (the classical control), and random modes; error = resolved-tendency error over the full subgrid contribution. Pilot: two seeded fields at n = 64 and 96; run: three fresh fields at n = 96 and 128; snapshots at t = 1 and 2, cutoffs 8 and 16, ranks 16 to 128 and the read operator's full rank.
bars: PREREG-D7.md Section 5; tolerances fixed from the pilot
